title: corylus pumila
intro: Corylus pumila, commonly known as the Siberian or dwarf hazel, is a shrub or small tree species native to Asia and Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal and edible properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases like heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Corylus pumila include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and even exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
